patterns: National Science Day (28 Feb, Raman Effect) is the single most repeated fact - asked plainly by APPSC and many PSCs.
APPSC asks Indian Science Congress venue/year (98th, 2011, Chennai) and new science platforms (DD Science + India Science, 2019).
Ministry-ownership traps recur: Vigyan Prasar = DST (not HRD), NCSM = Culture, Survey of India = S&T.
App covers academies (NASI/IASc/INSA order, HQs) and NIF in depth - fine but PYQs show little on academies; ISC venues/themes are under-covered in app MCQs.
